title: Cipher and Safehouse
author: B. M. Crane
blurb: Silas Eastwick, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
